note: null = TBD. Values from official LEAP Hand V1 sources are documented references, not measurements of this lab's unit. The lab LEFT hand does not follow the official ID layout (thumb 0-3, 57600 baud), so every hardware_verified flag must be set true by a person after checking the real right hand. Hardware mode refuses to start while anything is null or unverified.

evidence.motor_ids: Official V1 ID table: Index 0-3, Middle 4-7, Ring 8-11, Thumb 12-15; per finger MCP side, MCP forward, PIP, DIP. https://v1.leaphand.com/assembly and LEAP_Hand_API python/main.py (commit b0d00c8). Right hand is the default V1 build; left differs only in thumb assembly and palm (assembly page).
evidence.open_pose: Official V1 home pose: 180 deg (3.14159 rad) for every joint, horns are mounted at this pose (assembly page; leap_hand_utils.allegro_to_LEAPhand(zeros)).
evidence.close_pose: TBD. No official close pose exists. Record on the real right hand with torque OFF (right_hand_hw_check.py --record close).
evidence.direction: Official convention: a positive angle closes the joints; MCP side is centered at 180 and moves both ways (python/main.py header). Per-motor direction used by the controller comes from open -> close in this file, so it is only as good as the recorded close pose.
evidence.limits: Official V1 LEAPsim_limits + 3.14159 rad (leap_hand_utils.py, used by angle_safety_clip), identical to the joint limits in LEAP_Hand_Sim assets/leap_hand/robot.urdf.
evidence.baudrate: TBD. Official API opens 4000000; the lab left hand uses 57600. Check with a ping scan.
evidence.port: TBD. Use /dev/serial/by-id/... of the right hand U2D2 (official README recommends by-id).
evidence.profile_velocity: Operational value from start_left_hand_camera_safe_system.sh (--profile-velocity 8), not a hardware property.
evidence.allowed_operating_modes: 3 = position, 5 = current-based position (official API sets 5). Goal Position is only meaningful in these modes.
